description: This header file declares the LoggingPreferences class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The class implements plugin interface functionalities, including methods for enabling/disabling keystroke mask logging, event handling for keystroke mask changes, and interface map declarations. It also includes private methods for IARM initialization and deinitialization, as well as private copy constructors to prevent copying.

classes.name: LoggingPreferences
classes.description: A plugin class managing logging preferences, specifically keystroke masking, with methods for initialization, event handling, and interface mapping.

methods.name: isKeystrokeMaskEnabled
methods.description: Handles the request to check if keystroke mask is enabled.

methods.name: setKeystrokeMaskEnabled
methods.description: Handles the request to enable or disable keystroke masking.

methods.name: onKeystrokeMaskEnabledChange
methods.description: Event handler called when the keystroke mask enabled state changes.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin with the provided service.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin info; currently returns an empty string.
